selection_policy: Official specifications and official tooling documentation for telemetry, trace propagation, event envelopes, event API description, schemas and compatibility.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Specification Overview
supports: traces, metrics and logs data/SDK model
limitations: Telemetry is not domain state or evidence

sources.title: OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions
limitations: Aurora-specific conventions require their own specification

sources.title: W3C Trace Context
supports: traceparent and tracestate propagation across distributed systems
limitations: Trace context is not authentication or authorization

sources.title: CloudEvents Specification
limitations: Does not define Aurora event meaning, durability or ordering

sources.title: AsyncAPI Specification and Tooling
limitations: Does not enforce authority or runtime delivery semantics

sources.title: JSON Schema 2020-12
limitations: No built-in semantic compatibility or lifecycle behavior

sources.title: Protocol Buffers Overview
limitations: Not human-readable and not justified for all boundaries

sources.title: Buf Breaking Change Detection
limitations: Structural checks do not cover authority/evidence semantic changes
